job.title: Manager Health, Safety, Environment, Risk & Training
job.description:
About the opportunity
Stellar Recruitment is partnering with South32 to recruit a Manager Health, Safety, Environment, Risk & Training for Cannington Mine in northwest Queensland.

Reporting directly to the Vice President Operations, you will lead the site’s health and hygiene, safety, material risk, environment, training, emergency response and compliance functions. You will lead an established multidisciplinary team of approximately 21 people and serve as a key member of Cannington’s senior leadership team.

The technical foundations are established. The opportunity is to provide clear direction, strengthen leadership capability and accountability, and ensure priority programs of work are implemented effectively and sustained. Success will require a leader who can establish expectations, constructively challenge missed commitments, simplify priorities and consistently translate plans into operational outcomes.

This is a visible operational leadership role. You will work closely with leaders across the mine to strengthen ownership of health, safety, material risk, environment and workforce competency within the line organisation.

Key responsibilities
  • Lead, coach and develop the HSERT leadership team, creating a culture of care, accountability, constructive challenge and consistent delivery.
  • Set a clear strategic direction and focused annual operating plan across health and hygiene, safety, material risk, environment and training.
  • Translate strategy, assurance findings and improvement priorities into executable programs with clear accountabilities, milestones and measures of success.
  • Establish disciplined governance and follow-through, ensuring critical actions and commitments are completed to the required standard and timeframe.
  • Influence, coach and constructively challenge senior operational leaders to strengthen line ownership of safety, risk and workforce capability.
  • Provide visible field leadership and help leaders improve the quality of critical control management, operational routines and risk-based decision-making.
  • Strengthen material risk management, critical control verification, hazard identification, incident management and significant-event investigation.
  • Lead change across the HSERT function, including simplifying systems and redirecting specialist effort toward the activities that most effectively reduce risk and improve operational performance.
  • Oversee regulatory compliance, environmental approvals and reporting across the mine and associated rail and port activities.
  • Provide strategic leadership across health and hygiene, injury management, workers compensation, emergency response and training systems.
  • Build trusted, transparent relationships with operational leaders, corporate functions, contractors, regulators and external service providers.
  • Manage the function’s budget, performance reporting and improvement portfolio, connecting technical requirements with practical operational and commercial decisions.
About you
You are an experienced mining or heavy-industry leader who combines credible HSERT judgement with strong people leadership, operational influence and disciplined execution.

The strongest candidates will demonstrate:
  • Leadership of complex teams: At least five years’ experience leading a multidisciplinary team of 10 or more people, including senior technical or functional leaders.
  • Delivery and change leadership: A strong record of implementing significant change and delivering complex programs of work through clear priorities, effective governance and sustained follow-through.
  • Accountability and performance: Demonstrated ability to establish clear expectations, address missed commitments and improve team performance while maintaining trust and engagement.
  • Operational influence: The credibility and confidence to coach, influence and constructively challenge senior operational leaders, contractors, technical specialists and frontline teams.
  • Material risk leadership: Sound operational understanding of material risk, critical controls, significant-event management, regulatory compliance and management-system effectiveness.
  • Breadth across the HSERT portfolio: Sufficient exposure to environment, health and hygiene, emergency response and training to lead specialist expertise and make balanced, risk-based decisions.
  • Commercial judgement: Experience managing budgets and prioritising technical requirements, risk-reduction initiatives and business needs in a resource-constrained operational environment.
  • Communication and stakeholder leadership: Advanced communication, facilitation and influencing capability, including engagement with executives, regulators and workforce representatives.
  • Relevant qualifications: A bachelor’s degree in science, engineering, safety or a related discipline. Postgraduate qualifications in work health and safety will be highly regarded.
  • Roster flexibility: The ability to work a 4 days on, 3 days off roster and occasionally participate in an 8 days on, 6 days off duty-manager swing.
Why Cannington?
Cannington is a large, established underground base-metals operation offering the scale, complexity and operational exposure expected of a senior mining leadership role.

The position offers direct access to the Vice President Operations and genuine authority across the complete HSERT portfolio. You will inherit technically capable specialists and have the opportunity to strengthen alignment, leadership capability, accountability and execution across both the function and the broader operation.

This role will suit a senior leader who wants to make a visible operational impact, build a stronger team and deliver meaningful, sustained improvement in health, safety, risk, environment and workforce capability.

Benefits
  • Attractive 4 days on, 3 days off roster
  • Established multidisciplinary team of approximately 21 people
  • Broad influence across the complete HSERT portfolio
  • Senior position within Cannington’s operational leadership team
  • Competitive salary package
  • 14% superannuation contributions
  • Annual short-term incentive
If you are a senior mining or heavy-industry leader who combines strong judgement with visible, accountable people leadership and a proven ability to turn plans into sustained results, we welcome a confidential discussion.

For further information, contact Rob Gantly or Lucas Eyers at Stellar Recruitment, or select Apply Now to submit your application.

job.title: Procurement Manager
job.description:
Our Client:

Our client is a well-established and growing nationwide organisation, operating within the commercial construction sector. With a strong focus on quality, innovation, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction, the business is investing in its procurement capability to support continued growth.
This newly created position offers an experienced procurement professional the opportunity to take ownership of international sourcing, strengthen established supplier partnerships, and develop new supply channels across global markets.

About the Role:

As Procurement Manager, you will lead procurement activity across a wide range of construction and building products. You will manage and strengthen existing offshore supplier relationships while identifying new manufacturing and trade partnerships that improve commercial performance, product quality, and supply chain resilience.
Working closely with Regional Managers, Project Managers, senior leaders, finance, logistics partners, and international suppliers, you will oversee the complete procurement process, from sourcing and negotiation through to product testing, compliance, freight coordination, and delivery into New Zealand.
This is an autonomous position requiring strong commercial judgement, cultural awareness, and the confidence to establish trusted relationships across diverse international markets.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Manage, establish, and strengthen international supplier and manufacturing relationships
  • Identify and evaluate new offshore suppliers, products, and global sourcing opportunities
  • Lead sourcing, tendering, pricing reviews, contract negotiations, and commercial agreements
  • Coordinate product testing, compliance documentation, quality standards, and supplier warranties
  • Oversee international freight, shipping schedules, customs processes, and delivery into NZ
  • Partner with Regional and Project Managers to forecast demand, manage supply risks, and maintain product availability
Skills and Experience:
  • At least five years of procurement experience, ideally within building products, construction supply, manufacturing, or merchant environments
  • Proven experience managing offshore suppliers and developing international sourcing relationships
  • Strong commercial negotiation, strategic sourcing, contract management, and supplier evaluation capability
  • Practical knowledge of international logistics, freight, customs, product testing, and supply chain risk
  • Confident communication, analytical, reporting, relationship management, and cross cultural collaboration skills
  • A current passport and willingness to travel internationally, with additional language capability advantageous but not essential
This is a high impact position for a self motivated procurement professional who enjoys working independently, developing trusted supplier relationships, and delivering measurable commercial value. You will have the opportunity to influence procurement strategy while contributing directly to the growth and resilience of a progressive construction organisation.

How to Apply:

If you thrive on developing global supplier relationships and identifying new commercial opportunities, we would welcome your application.

job.title: Legal Counsel
job.description:
About the Role
This is a rare opportunity to step into a sole counsel role within a diversified property and investment business.

Working directly with senior leadership, you'll provide advice across commercial property, leasing, disputes, governance, compliance and wider business initiatives. Your role will extend beyond technical legal support, with regular involvement in commercial discussions, project work and matters that influence business outcomes.

The work is broad, commercially focused and highly visible. You'll be exposed to everything from day-to-day operational issues through to acquisitions, development projects, dispute resolution and strategic business decisions.

For a lawyer who enjoys variety and wants to be part of the decision-making process rather than reviewing matters from the sidelines, this role offers significant breadth and engagement.

Key Work
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Drafting, reviewing and negotiating commercial agreements
  • Advising on leasing, licensing and commercial property matters
  • Supporting acquisitions, disposals and development projects
  • Managing disputes, claims and contentious matters
  • Providing legal advice on risk, governance and compliance issues
  • Partnering with senior stakeholders on strategic initiatives
  • Managing relationships with external legal advisers
  • Supporting legal operations and process improvement
  • Assisting with financing, investment and transactional activity
The work is varied and business-facing, requiring the ability to switch between operational matters and higher-level commercial projects.  

About You:
  • NZ qualified lawyer with approximately 6+ years PQE
  • Strong commercial property, leasing and transactional experience
  • Experience drafting and negotiating complex commercial agreements
  • Sound judgement and a pragmatic approach to legal risk
  • Confidence engaging directly with senior stakeholders
  • Strong commercial awareness and business acumen
  • Ability to prioritise effectively across multiple matters
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to provide practical recommendations
Lawyers from property, commercial or real estate-focused practices are likely to find the transition particularly relevant. However, candidates with a blend of private practice and in-house experience will also be considered.  

The Opportunity
Many legal counsel roles focus on a single business unit or operate within larger legal teams.

This role offers something broader.

As the sole legal adviser, you'll gain exposure across a wide range of legal and commercial issues while working closely with the people responsible for the direction of the business. Your advice will contribute to decisions involving property, investment, operational and strategic matters, providing variety that is often difficult to find in more specialised roles.

The breadth of work will appeal to lawyers who enjoy applying their legal expertise across multiple disciplines while remaining closely connected to the commercial realities of the business.

What Success Looks Like
This is a fast-paced commercial environment where priorities can shift quickly, and legal advice is expected to be practical, commercially aware and clearly communicated.

Success in the role comes from developing a strong understanding of the business, maintaining momentum across multiple matters and exercising sound judgement when balancing risk, opportunity and commercial objectives. You'll work closely with senior decision-makers who value clear recommendations, thoughtful analysis and a solutions-focused approach.

The breadth of work, visibility across the organisation and pace of decision-making will appeal to lawyers who enjoy responsibility, variety and a broad mix of legal and commercial challenges.

About the Business
This established Auckland-based business owns, manages and invests in a substantial portfolio of commercial assets and related ventures.

The legal function supports a broad range of activities across property, investment and operational matters, creating exposure that extends well beyond a traditional property law role.

The result is a role that combines technical legal work with genuine commercial involvement, allowing the successful lawyer to become a trusted adviser across the wider business.

How to Apply
Click "QUICK APPLY" or send your CV & Aacademic Transcripts to jenny.g@stellarrecruitment.co.nz, or for a confidential chat, call Jenny on 021 0230 3960.

Please include your academic transcript with your CV, as this forms part of the initial review.

  • Experience developing Departmental Functional Briefs
  • Experience working across significant healthcare infrastructure projects
  • Strong clinical user engagement and stakeholder management capability
  • Ability to confidently engage with clinicians and health professionals around facility planning requirements
  • Strong communication, facilitation and leadership skills
  • Ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary project teams
Please note: This requirement is specifically focused on candidates with a clinical background and health facility planning expertise rather than candidates coming solely from an architectural background.
 
The Opportunity
This is an opportunity to work across complex and meaningful healthcare infrastructure programmes where your clinical knowledge and facility planning expertise will directly influence how healthcare environments are planned and delivered.
 
The position can be based Australia wide, providing access to a diverse portfolio of health projects and the opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals across the healthcare and project advisory space.
 
If you have a clinical background and established experience in health facility planning, particularly developing Schedules of Accommodation and Departmental Functional Briefs, we would be interested in hearing from you.
 
Apply now for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Heavy Diesel Mechanic
job.description:
About the job opportunity

We have partnered with a highly respected and long-established leader in New Zealand's commercial vehicle industry to find an experienced Heavy Diesel Mechanic for their Wellington workshop.

With more than three decades of success, this Kiwi-owned business has built a reputation for quality, reliability, and exceptional customer service. Operating nationwide and supporting some of the world's leading commercial vehicle brands, they offer genuine long-term career stability, modern workshop facilities, and a team culture built around respect, teamwork, and professional development.

This is a Monday to Friday role working within a well-equipped workshop alongside experienced technicians who take pride in delivering high-quality workmanship. You'll enjoy variety in your day-to-day work while supporting a diverse fleet of commercial vehicles and helping keep New Zealand's transport industry moving.

If you're looking for a stable role with a business that values its people, invests in training, and offers genuine career progression opportunities, we'd love to hear from you.
  

Key Responsibilities
  • Service, maintain, and repair heavy diesel trucks and commercial vehicles
  • Carry out diagnostics and fault-finding across mechanical, hydraulic, and electrical systems
  • Diagnose and repair breakdowns efficiently and safely
  • Maintain accurate service records and workshop documentation
  • Work collaboratively with the wider workshop team to achieve operational targets
  • - Ensure all work is completed to a high standard while maintaining strong safety practices
  
Benefits
  • Up to $48 per hour depending on experience
  • Overtime opportunities available
  • Tool allowance provided
  • Ongoing manufacturer and industry training
  • Modern workshop and equipment
  • Monday to Friday schedule with consistent hours
  • Supportive team environment with experienced leadership
  • Long-term job security with a nationally recognised business
  • Genuine career progression opportunities within a growing organisation
  
About you
  • Trade qualified Heavy Diesel Mechanic
  • Experience working on heavy vehicles, trucks, and trailers
  • Ability to independently carry out maintenance, servicing, and repairs
  • Strong diagnostic and fault-finding skills
  • Professional, reliable, and able to work well with others
  
How to apply:

Click APPLY or contact Frankie for a confidential discussion Frankie.g@stellarrecruitment.co.nz
